duration.text: The Physical Electronics at Beijing Jiaotong University is a 2 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3611 USD/per year ￥ 26000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Transcript of undergraduate school 5. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 4 or above 6. Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record. 7. Two recommendation letters From professor,associate professor or equivalents. 8. Photocopy of Guarantee Letter(shandong) A Guarantee Letter (click to have a look at the sample) from your school, the education agency or consulting company to prove you are in good conduct is compulsory. Click here to download the template and seal it, and then upload the photocopy through SICAS.

requirements.text: Chinese Bachelor's Degree or an equivalent; two recommendations by two professors or associate professors; pass of relevant examinations
